description: One school's whole peers and feeders view, as one record, the same one the portal's page draws: the groups (competitors, similar programs and feeders worked out for every school under the criteria set on the Manage card's run; athletic conference not held; saved groups as overrides, without who saved them), the criteria and the run, and for the school and each peer: the agreements held with each feeder (counted kinds apart from other ties), the published and inferred rules taking each feeder's courses, the school's View counts and prior-learning policy rows, and each peer's own feeders. With program (42.01 Psychology or 52.01 Business), also applicability: the share of each feeder's associate-checklist courses that count at the school and each peer, by compare_my_school. The answer's html is the page as the portal draws it. Answered to every caller; no share is in this answer. Nothing is saved by this read.

draw.description: Optional: false leaves out the page's html; true or absent carries it

program.description: Optional: also read applicability for this program (CIP)
